name: Grader Circuit-Breaker Trip Against amd-halo
goal: Reproduce the real cause of the grader circuit breaker tripping against amd-halo with live evidence, then implement only the branch that evidence confirms.

tasks.name: Live root-cause investigation
tasks.description: Read-only/network diagnostic. Determines H1 (amd-halo ignores disable-thinking fields, slow response trips some timeout, at least one alternate field combination confirmed to work) vs H2 (amd-halo genuinely network-unreachable, breaker correct) vs inconclusive (either already-fine or no candidate suppresses thinking). Evidence excludes /tmp/ic/daemon.log narration and episodic-memory archive results (both flagged inadmissible/fabricated this session). Revised after tier-up review found the prior version tested only 2 field variants, could never produce a 'confirmed-working field' for Task 2's H1 branch, and used a non-grading-shaped probe.

steps.description: Identify live Commander daemon process; record PID, start time, and full command line including interpreter path.
steps.command: ps aux | grep "ironclaude.main" | grep -v grep

steps.description: Identify the primary checkout's path and HEAD without naming its path as a command argument (a direct path reference, e.g. git -C <primary-path>, is blocked by managed-worktree enforcement even for reads). Compare against this worktree's 255d594 and Step 1's interpreter path.

steps.description: Probe amd-halo reachability; capture the FULL /v1/models response body (not discarded) to identify the server implementation, which informs which Step 5 candidates are plausible.
steps.command: curl -sS -m 5 -w "\nhttp_code=%{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}\n" http://amd-halo:8080/v1/models

steps.description: If reachable: baseline grader payload (current suppression fields). Record full response body, latency, and check explicitly for 3 thinking-presence signals: (1) a reasoning_content/reasoning field anywhere in the response, (2) finish_reason=='length' with empty/near-empty message.content, (3) <think> tags in message.content.
steps.command: curl -sS -m 60 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code} TIME:%{time_total}\n" http://amd-halo:8080/v1/chat/completions -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer ollama" -d '{"model":"gemma4-26b-a4b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly the word: ok"}],"max_tokens":16,"temperature":0.1,"reasoning_effort":"none","chat_template_kwargs":{"enable_thinking":false}}'

steps.description: Write the finding to the findings file, based only on this task's own step output — not on /tmp/ic/daemon.log or episodic-memory archive content. H1 = reachable, current fields showed a thinking-presence signal, AND at least one candidate showed none. H2 = unreachable. Inconclusive = reachable and current fields already suppress thinking (no fix needed), OR current fields fail and no candidate works either. This finding gates Task 2's branch.
